$versionScript = @'
import fs from 'node:fs';
for(const f of ['package.json','package-lock.json']) {const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f)); p.version='0.3.9'; if(p.packages?.[''])p.packages[''].version='0.3.9';fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n');}
'@
$versionScript | node --input-type=module
& 'node_modules/.bin/prettier.cmd' --write src/capture-policy.js src/recorder-supervisor.js src/automation.js src/health.js src/util.js src/core.js src/portable.js src/cli-help.js bin/dip.js test/privacy-recovery.test.js docs/operations.md QA_REPORT.md README.md
npm run check
